Featuring handpicked boutique accommodations such as Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa, Emeraude Classic Cruise, Chapa Express Train, Sapa Jade Hill Resort, Radisson RED Danang Hotel, La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa, and Mai House Saigon.

itinerary_p: Your private 14D13N journey — 14 days, carefully crafted.

itinerary.title: Day 1 — Hanoi
description: Arrival in Hanoi by CX741. Enjoy pre-booked Early Check-in at Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa and rest for half a day. In the evening, gather for a Welcome Dinner followed by an Evening Hanoi Short Walking Tour to ease into the local rhythm.
activities: Airport transfer, Early check-in, Welcome Dinner, Evening Walking Tour.

itinerary.title: Day 2 — Hanoi
description: Full Day Ninh Binh Tour from Hanoi. Discover the historic ancient capital of Hoa Lu, the grand Bai Dinh Pagoda, serene sampan boat ride through Trang An landscape, and panoramic views from Mua Cave.
activities: Private AC transfer, guide, entrance tickets, Trang An boat tour, Lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 3 — Halong Bay
description: Morning transfer to Ha Long Bay. Embark on the Emeraude Classic Cruise and check into the Captain Suite. Enjoy afternoon cruise activities, kayaking, swimming, and an overnight stay amidst UNESCO karst waters.
activities: Private transfer, Emeraude Cruise, Captain Suite, Lunch, Dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 4 — Hanoi
description: Morning cruise activities on Ha Long Bay including Tai Chi and cave visits. Enjoy brunch on board before disembarking and transferring back to Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa for relaxation.
activities: Morning cruise activity, transfer back to Hanoi, hotel stay.

itinerary.title: Day 5 — Hanoi
description: Full Day Hanoi City Tour exploring historic landmarks such as Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, One Pillar Pagoda, Temple of Literature, and the vibrant Old Quarter.
activities: Private guide, entrance fees, city tour, Lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 6 — Hanoi
description: Hat Village & Incense Village Half Day Tour from Hanoi. Free afternoon in Hanoi for leisure and exploration. In the evening, transfer to Hanoi Railway Station to board the overnight Chapa Express Train to Sapa in a Suite Queen Cabin.
activities: Incense & Hat village tour, transfer to Hanoi station, Chapa Express Suite Cabin, Lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 7 — Sapa
description: Arrival in Lao Cai/Sapa. Embark on a Full Day Sapa Tour exploring lush rice terraces, local hill-tribe villages, and check in at Sapa Jade Hill Resort (Mountain View Bungalow).
activities: Station pickup, guided Sapa tour, bungalow stay, Lunch, Dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 8 — Da Nang
description: Enjoy a free morning in Sapa. After lunch, transfer to the airport for a domestic flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, private transfer to Radisson RED Danang Hotel.
activities: Airport transfer, domestic flight, Da Nang pickup & hotel stay, Lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 9 — Da Nang
description: Full Day Da Nang City Tour highlighting Marble Mountains, Son Tra Peninsula (Linh Ung Pagoda), Dragon Bridge, and local cultural spots.
activities: Private guide & vehicle, entrance tickets, Lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 10 — Hoi An
description: Full Day Hoi An Tour. Transfer to Hoi An Ancient Town, explore lantern-lit streets, Japanese Covered Bridge, and stay at La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa (Deluxe Balcony Queen Classic Wing).
activities: Transfer to Hoi An, guided walking tour, resort check-in, Lunch, Dinner.

itinerary.title: Day 11 — Hoi An
description: Morning Hoi An Countryside Cycling Tour through peaceful villages and organic gardens. Free afternoon in Hoi An Ancient Town with custom tailoring recommendations.
activities: Countryside cycling tour, guide, tailoring recommendation, Lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 12 — Ho Chi Minh City
description: Transfer to Da Nang Airport and fly to Ho Chi Minh City. In the afternoon, take a guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels before checking in at Mai House (Premium King Room).
activities: Airport transfers, domestic flight, Cu Chi Tunnels entry & tour, Lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 13 — Ho Chi Minh City
description: Full Day Mekong Delta Tour. Cruise down peaceful waterways, visit local artisanal workshops, taste tropical fruits, and experience southern river life.
activities: Private Mekong excursion, boat trip, guide, Lunch.

itinerary.title: Day 14 — Ho Chi Minh City
description: Half Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour exploring Saigon Notre-Dame Basilica, Central Post Office, and War Remnants Museum. Relax before private transfer to the airport for departure flight.
activities: Half day city tour, airport departure transfer, Dinner.

letter_intro: I am delighted to present this privately arranged journey: PROGRAM OVERVIEW, created for Sara (2 Pax) travelling from 30 Mar – 12 Apr 2027. The route unfolds from Hanoi – Halong Bay – Hanoi – Sapa – Da Nang – Hoi An – Ho Chi Minh City.
letter_body_p2: The programme has been considered around a gentler family rhythm: early check-in in Hanoi, private guiding and transfers, a premium overnight train cabin, and enough space between active days to pause. Dining, room arrangements and transitions have been planned with care, without adding unnecessary movement.
letter_outro: Please review the journey as a starting point for a personal conversation. Every final detail can be refined around your preferred pace, room choices and family priorities.

why_comfort: Rest easy with handpicked boutique hotels, early check-in pre-booked on arrival, and premium sleeper cabins on Chapa Express.
why_muslim: Dietary requirements and special meal preferences pre-arranged seamlessly at every destination.
why_balanced: A perfect balance of historic cities, serene limestone cruise, mountain scenery in Sapa, heritage towns, and vibrant city culture.

hotels.name: Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa
hotels.introduction: Nestled in the historic Ba Dinh district, Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa blends French colonial charm with modern hospitality. It offers elegant rooms, a rooftop bar with spectacular city views, and a serene spa for a perfect urban retreat.

hotels.name: Emeraude Classic Cruise
hotels.introduction: Emeraude Cruises is a premier luxury cruise line operating in Ha Long Bay, managed by Thien Minh Group (TMG). Inspired by the legendary 1906 French paddle steamer, Emeraude offers a refined journey blending Indochine vintage charm with modern elegance and top-tier safety standards.

hotels.name: Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa
hotels.introduction: Nestled in the historic Ba Dinh district, Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa blends French colonial charm with modern hospitality. It offers elegant rooms, a rooftop bar with spectacular city views, and a serene spa for a perfect urban retreat.

hotels.name: Chapa Express Train
hotels.introduction: Chapa Express Train offers premium overnight sleeper service between Hanoi and Lao Cai (Sapa). Featuring traditional wooden panels, comfortable air-conditioned cabins, clean amenities, and personalized passenger hospitality.

hotels.name: Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa
hotels.introduction: Located in the scenic mist-covered hills of Sapa, Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa features stunning panoramic views of Fansipan mountain and Muong Hoa valley. Designed with local heritage details, the hotel offers comfortable heated bungalows, an outdoor pool, and local gourmet dining.

hotels.name: Radisson RED Danang Hotel
hotels.introduction: Radisson RED Danang Hotel offers refined luxury accommodations, personalized service, and modern comforts.

hotels.name: La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa
hotels.introduction: La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa offers refined luxury accommodations, personalized service, and modern comforts.

hotels.name: Mai House Hotel
hotels.introduction: Mai House Saigon Hotel is a luxury 5-star hotel ideally located in District 3, right next to the vibrant center of District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City. Featuring an elegant Neoclassical architecture with a touch of timeless nostalgia, Mai House offers guest spaces that blend modern luxury with warm hospitality and attentive service.

room_notes: Double Room / Twin sharing. Early check-in included in Hanoi.

edited_fields.lede: A Privately Arranged Family Journey from Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City.
edited_fields.letter_highlight: This journey was designed to leave room for both discovery and rest.
edited_fields.letter_intro: I am delighted to present this privately arranged journey: " Vietnam Rails, Mountains and Shores with Saigon Finale", created for 2 passengers travelling from 30 Mar – 12 Apr 2027. The route unfolds from Hanoi – Halong Bay – Sapa – Da Nang – Hoi An – Ho Chi Minh City.
edited_fields.letter_body_p2: The programme has been considered around an active rhythm: early check-in in Hanoi, private guiding and transfers, a premium overnight train cabin, and enough space between active days to pause. Dining, room arrangements and transitions have been planned with care, without adding unnecessary movement.
edited_fields.letter_outro: Please review the journey as a starting point for a personal conversation. Every final detail can be refined around your preferred pace, room choices and family priorities.

edited_fields.divider_itinerary_tagline:
A sequence of places, textures and quiet
            transitions — composed to be experienced rather than rushed.
edited_fields.itinerary_p: Your private 14D13N journey — 14 days, carefully crafted.
edited_fields.day_desc_1_0: Arrival in Hanoi by CX741. Enjoy pre-booked Early Check-in at Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa and rest for half a day. In the evening, gather for a Welcome Dinner followed by an Evening Hanoi Short Walking Tour to ease into the local rhythm.
edited_fields.day_highlights_1: Airport transfer · Early check · in · Welcome Dinner · Evening Walking Tour.
edited_fields.day_desc_2_0: Full Day Ninh Binh Tour from Hanoi. Discover the historic ancient capital of Hoa Lu, the grand Bai Dinh Pagoda, serene sampan boat ride through Trang An landscape, and panoramic views from Mua Cave. After your journey, come back to Hanoi to spend the night.
edited_fields.day_highlights_2: Private AC transfer · guide · entrance tickets · Trang An boat tour · Lunch.
edited_fields.day_desc_3_0: Morning transfer to Ha Long Bay. Embark on the Emeraude Classic Cruise and check into the Captain Suite. Enjoy afternoon cruise activities, kayaking, swimming, and an overnight stay amidst UNESCO karst waters.
edited_fields.day_highlights_3: Private transfer · Emeraude Cruise · Captain Suite · Lunch · Dinner.
edited_fields.day_desc_4_0: Morning cruise activities on Ha Long Bay including Tai Chi and cave visits. Enjoy brunch on board before disembarking and transferring back to Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa for relaxation.
edited_fields.day_highlights_4: Morning cruise activity · transfer back to Hanoi · hotel stay.
edited_fields.day_desc_5_0: Full Day Hanoi City Tour exploring historic landmarks such as Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, One Pillar Pagoda, Temple of Literature, and the vibrant Old Quarter.
edited_fields.day_highlights_5: Private guide · entrance fees · city tour · Lunch.
edited_fields.day_desc_6_0: Visit the Hat Village & Incense Village for a Half Day Tour from Hanoi. Free afternoon in Hanoi for leisure and exploration. In the evening, transfer to Hanoi Railway Station to board the overnight Chapa Express Train to Sapa in a Suite Queen Cabin.
edited_fields.day_highlights_6: Incense & Hat village tour · transfer to Hanoi station · Chapa Express Suite Cabin · Lunch.
edited_fields.day_desc_7_0: Arrival in Lao Cai/Sapa. Embark on a Full Day Sapa Tour exploring lush rice terraces, local hill-tribe villages, and check in at Sapa Jade Hill Resort (Mountain View Bungalow).
edited_fields.day_highlights_7: Station pickup · guided Sapa tour · bungalow stay · Lunch · Dinner.
edited_fields.day_desc_8_0: Enjoy a free morning in Sapa. After lunch, transfer to the airport for a domestic flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, private transfer to Radisson RED Danang Hotel.
edited_fields.day_highlights_8: Airport transfer · domestic flight · Da Nang pickup & hotel stay · Lunch.
edited_fields.day_desc_9_0: Full Day Da Nang City Tour highlighting Marble Mountains, Son Tra Peninsula (Linh Ung Pagoda), Dragon Bridge, and local cultural spots.
edited_fields.day_highlights_9: Private guide & vehicle · entrance tickets · Lunch.
edited_fields.day_desc_10_0: Full Day Hoi An Tour. Transfer to Hoi An Ancient Town, explore lantern-lit streets, Japanese Covered Bridge, and stay at La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa (Deluxe Balcony Queen Classic Wing).
edited_fields.day_highlights_10: Transfer to Hoi An · guided walking tour · resort check · in · Lunch · Dinner.
edited_fields.day_desc_11_0: Morning Hoi An Countryside Cycling Tour through peaceful villages and organic gardens. Free afternoon in Hoi An Ancient Town with custom tailoring recommendations.
edited_fields.day_highlights_11: Countryside cycling tour · guide · tailoring recommendation · Lunch.
edited_fields.day_desc_12_0: Transfer to Da Nang Airport and fly to Ho Chi Minh City. In the afternoon, take a guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels before checking in at Mai House (Premium King Room).
edited_fields.day_highlights_12: Airport transfers · domestic flight · Cu Chi Tunnels entry & tour · Lunch.
edited_fields.day_desc_13_0: Full Day Mekong Delta Tour. Cruise down peaceful waterways, visit local artisanal workshops, taste tropical fruits, and experience southern river life.
edited_fields.day_highlights_13: Private Mekong excursion · boat trip · guide · Lunch.
edited_fields.day_desc_14_0: Half Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour exploring Saigon Notre-Dame Basilica, Central Post Office, and War Remnants Museum. Relax before private transfer to the airport for departure flight.
edited_fields.day_highlights_14: Half day city tour · airport departure transfer · Dinner.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_1: Nestled in the historic Ba Dinh district, Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa blends French colonial charm with modern hospitality. It offers elegant rooms, a rooftop bar with spectacular city views, and a serene spa for a perfect urban retreat.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_2: Emeraude Cruises is a premier luxury cruise line operating in Ha Long Bay, managed by Thien Minh Group (TMG). Inspired by the legendary 1906 French paddle steamer, Emeraude offers a refined journey blending Indochine vintage charm with modern elegance and top-tier safety standards.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_4: Chapa Express Train offers premium overnight sleeper service between Hanoi and Lao Cai (Sapa). Featuring traditional wooden panels, comfortable air-conditioned cabins, clean amenities, and personalized passenger hospitality.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_5: Located in the scenic mist-covered hills of Sapa, Sapa Jade Hill Resort & Spa features stunning panoramic views of Fansipan mountain and Muong Hoa valley. Designed with local heritage details, the hotel offers comfortable heated bungalows, an outdoor pool, and local gourmet dining.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_6: Radisson RED Danang Hotel offers refined luxury accommodations, personalized service, and modern comforts.
edited_fields.hotel_name_7: La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa
edited_fields.hotel_intro_7: La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa offers refined luxury accommodations, personalized service, and modern comforts.
edited_fields.hotel_intro_8: Mai House Saigon Hotel is a luxury 5-star hotel ideally located in District 3, right next to the vibrant center of District 1 in Ho Chi Minh City. Featuring an elegant Neoclassical architecture with a touch of timeless nostalgia, Mai House offers guest spaces that blend modern luxury with warm hospitality and attentive service.
edited_fields.room_notes: Double Room / Twin sharing. Early check-in included in Hanoi.

              arranged, carefully paced and shaped around your comfort throughout.
